quotes.works_online: EGV can be redeemed only at www.yatra.com.
quotes.works_in_store: EGV can be redeemed only at www.yatra.com.
quotes.partial_redemption: EGV is valid for multiple/partial redemption until the full value is exhausted within the validity period.
quotes.max_vouchers_per_bill: Two or more EGVs cannot be combined in a single transaction.
quotes.can_combine_with_store_offers: EGV cannot be clubbed with any other offer, discount, cashback, or promotion.
quotes.validity: EGV is valid for a period of 12 months from the date of issue.
quotes.spend_scope: EGV is valid for booking of: Hotels (Domestic), Holidays (Domestic/International)
quotes.excludes: EGV is not applicable on Flights, Buses, Prime Membership, Cabs, or any services other than Hotels (Domestic) and Holidays.
